_readme: Featured Projects source of truth. GENERATED SURFACES stamped from this file
OURWORK-HEAD-SCHEMA regions), the OURWORK-STRIP 'Recent jobs' regions on the
/services/ hub pages, and docs/assets/data/homeowner-wall.json. Edit here,
then run: node scripts/build-projects.mjs — and commit ALL stamped files.
TAXONOMY: services[] is required — 1+ of roof-replacement|roof-repair|
roof-inspection (the /services/ hub filenames). It drives the /our-work
filter buttons, #service= deep links, schema serviceType, the card pills,
and which hub-page strips a job appears in. category is legacy/optional.
SORTING: surfaces render newest published first — APPEND new entries at the
END of this array; same-date entries keep array order.
HARD RULES: retail prices only (priceLow/priceHigh, both or neither, whole
dollars) — never cost/margin figures; city-level location only, never a real
location; photos must be re-encoded copies under /assets/images/projects/
(the re-encode strips EXIF), never CRM storage URLs; consentOnFile must be
true or the build refuses the entry; a future published date stages the
entry until the first deploy after that date.

projects.title: Brick Colonial — Full Re-Roof
projects.description: Architectural shingle replacement on a two-story colonial. New drip edge, starter strip, and ridge vent. Curb appeal speaks for itself.

photos.alt: Completed roof on brick colonial home with spring landscaping

projects.title: Brick Two-Story — Drone Verified
projects.description: Complete tear-off and replacement. Every project gets drone documentation so the homeowner can see exactly what was done — and so can the insurance company.

photos.alt: Aerial drone view of completed brick home roof replacement

projects.title: Multi-Section Complex Roof
projects.description: Large footprint with multiple roof sections, valleys, and transitions. New underlayment throughout, architectural shingles, all flashing replaced.

projects.title: Wind Damage — Lifted & Missing Shingles
projects.description: High winds peeled back shingles and exposed underlayment. Documented damage for insurance claim, full replacement approved and completed within two weeks.

photos.alt: Storm damaged roof with lifted and missing shingles

projects.title: Hail Impact — Chalk-Marked Inspection
projects.description: I mark every impact with chalk during inspection so the adjuster can verify. This roof had 50+ hits per test square — clear approval for full replacement.

photos.alt: Chalk-marked hail damage during roof inspection

projects.title: Full Crew — Cul-de-Sac Tear-Off
projects.description: Branded trucks, tarps down, materials staged, crew on the roof. This is what a professional jobsite looks like. Neighbors took notice — two more estimates booked that week.

photos.alt: NBD crew actively working on roof tear-off in residential neighborhood

projects.title: Underlayment Install — Premium Brick Home
projects.description: Hi-vis crew laying synthetic underlayment on a large brick two-story. Materials staged, safety protocols in place. The decking underneath was clean — no surprises.

photos.alt: Crew installing synthetic underlayment on large brick home

projects.title: Valley Flashing Detail — Precision Install
projects.description: Metal valley flashing with tight shingle cuts on both sides, new pipe boot sealed properly. This is the kind of detail work that prevents leaks for decades. No shortcuts.

photos.alt: Clean metal valley flashing with new architectural shingles on both sides

projects.title: Two Properties — One Day
projects.description: Side-by-side tear-offs on neighboring properties. Full decking exposed, materials staged, crew running both roofs. Efficiency at scale — no wasted time.

photos.alt: Aerial drone shot of two roofs being replaced simultaneously

projects.title: Apartment Complex — Multi-Building Tear-Off
projects.description: Full-scale commercial project: multi-building apartment complex, complete tear-off down to decking, new synthetic underlayment going down while crew stages shingle bundles. Multiple buildings, one crew, zero delays.

photos.alt: Aerial drone view of apartment building mid-tearoff with blue underlayment and crew working

projects.title: Apartment Complex — All Buildings Complete
projects.description: Same complex, job done. Every building re-roofed with architectural shingles, new ridge vents, all flashing replaced. Drone-documented start to finish for the property management company.

photos.alt: Aerial drone view of completed multi-building apartment complex with new roofs

projects.title: A-Frame Cabin — Standing Seam Metal
projects.description: Not every job is shingles. This mountain A-frame got a standing seam metal roof — built for steep pitch, heavy snow loads, and decades of zero maintenance.

photos.alt: A-frame cabin with standing seam metal roof

projects.title: Brick Tudor Duplex — Designer Re-Roof
projects.description: Full tear-off on a brick Tudor duplex: designer-blend shingles over fresh underlayment, the original built-in box gutters relined, and new chimney flashing cut in. Old-bones buildings deserve to be done right.

photos.alt: Overhead drone view of the finished designer-blend shingle roof on a brick Tudor duplex with relined box gutters and coated porch roof
Top-down view of underlayment day: synthetic underlayment field with staged shingle bundles and safety lines on the duplex roof
Crew member sealing new chimney flashing at the ridge of the freshly shingled designer-blend hip roof
Close-up of the relined built-in box gutter running along the edge of the new designer shingles
New black step and counter-flashing worked into the brick chimney beside the designer-blend shingles
